meta.name: Vitriol Splash Scrim
meta.description: A field textile made of vitriol crystal. Placed on the quarry strata, it softens and dampens unintended splash impacts, turning the crucible's explosive force into a soft hum. As part of The Alkahest Vitriol & Abyssal Hydro-Works, this permanent umber-woven manual allows hydro-alchemists to safely protect valuable ores. It will never wear out.
